_comment: Paired tasks for paired_experiment.py. Paths are relative to this file. `check` runs in the task's work dir with ANSWER_FILE set; exit 0 = success; checks compare the exact set of file:line locations so an answer that adds a wrong location fails. Context files were written by `C2D_CONDENSED_OUT=<dir> swift test --filter OutputCondenserFixtureTests` (raw = the fixture itself). No fixture separates all three arms: lossless differs from raw only on grep_many, and on grep_many the lossy options add nothing; arms with identical context are flagged in the plan and act as A/A controls.

tasks.question: Which tests failed? For each, give the test name and the exact file:line:column of the failed expectation. Answer in plain text, one per line.
tasks.check: grep -q addsNegative "$ANSWER_FILE" && test "$(grep -oE 'LibTests\.swift:[0-9]+:[0-9]+' "$ANSWER_FILE" | sort -u | tr '\n' ' ')" = 'LibTests.swift:3:21 LibTests.swift:5:29 '

tasks.question: List every compiler error as file:line:column followed by the message. Answer in plain text, one per line.
Which file has the most matching lines in this grep output, and exactly how many matching lines does it have? Answer as `path: count` on one line.
